newsitem.title: UK: UK's Caspian to develop new complex.
newsitem.headline: UK's Caspian to develop new complex.

text.p: Caspian Group Plc, owners of English premier league soccer club Leeds United, said on Monday it had been selected as preferred developer of a new multi-purpose arena to be integrated with Leeds United's stadium in northern England.
Caspian had been selected by Leeds City Council and the arena will have a capacity of 13,000 spectators.
Caspian would also redevelop the west stand of its existing stadium and increase its capacity to 45,000.
Chris Akers, Caspian's chairman, told Reuters the company expected to start construction towards the end of this year and complete it by June 1999.
Akers said the details of funding the project would be announced in four to six weeks.
When asked whether Caspian would like to raise fresh equity, he said: "no, not at this stage".
